001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModelDefinition;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.INamedModelInstance;
006import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
007
008import java.util.stream.Stream;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Represents a Metapath node item for a Metaschema model instance (assembly or
014 * field).
015 *
016 * @param <D>
017 *          the Java type of the model definition
018 * @param <I>
019 *          the Java type of the model instance
020 */
021public interface IModelNodeItem<D extends IModelDefinition, I extends INamedModelInstance>
022    extends IDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
023
024  @Override
025  int getPosition();
026
027  /**
028   * {@inheritDoc}
029   * <p>
030   * The parent can be an assembly or a document (in the case of a root assembly.
031   */
032  @Override
033  INodeItem getParentNodeItem();
034
035  @Override
036  IAssemblyNodeItem getParentContentNodeItem();
037
038  @Override
039  @NonNull
040  default Stream<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> descendantOrSelf() {
041    return ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.concat(Stream.of(this), descendant()));
042  }
043
044  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
045  @Override
046  @NonNull
047  default Stream<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> followingSibling() {
048    IModelNodeItem<?, ?> parent = getParentContentNodeItem();
049    return ObjectUtils.notNull(parent == null
050        ? Stream.empty()
051        : parent.modelItems()
052            // need to use != vs !Object.equals to ensure we are matching the same object
053            .dropWhile(item -> this != item)
054            .skip(1));
055  }
056
057  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
058  @Override
059  @NonNull
060  default Stream<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> precedingSibling() {
061    IModelNodeItem<?, ?> parent = getParentContentNodeItem();
062    return ObjectUtils.notNull(parent == null
063        ? Stream.empty()
064        // need to use != vs !Object.equals to ensure we are matching the same object
065        : parent.modelItems().takeWhile(item -> this != item));
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  default Stream<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> following() {
070    return followingSibling()
071        .flatMap(IModelNodeItem::descendantOrSelf);
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  default Stream<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> preceding() {
076    return precedingSibling()
077        .flatMap(IModelNodeItem::descendantOrSelf);
078  }
079}
